prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 86 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A dynamic instrumental track featuring electric guitar, bass, drums, and synthesizers. It begins with a melancholic, clean guitar melody over a steady rhythm section, gradually building in intensity with added synth layers and a more powerful, slightly distorted guitar sound, creating an epic and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的纯音乐曲目，以电吉他、贝斯、鼓和合成器为特色。它以忧郁、干净的吉他旋律在稳定的节奏部分上开始，逐渐增加合成器层和更强劲、略带失真的吉他音色，营造出史诗般且富有反思性的氛围。
